exposure: multiparae planning a second vaginal birth
outcome: Timing of spontaneous rupture of membranes (SROM)
Timing of interventions (amniotomy, oxytocin, epidural analgesia, opioids)
Labor duration (overall, first stage, second stage)
cohort: Pregnant women planning vaginal birth, including primiparae, multiparae with one previous c-section planning a VBAC, and multiparae with one previous vaginal birth
finding: Multiparous women planning a VBAC had labor patterns that differed from both primiparae and multiparae planning a second vaginal birth, with labor progression resembling primiparae but a shorter second stage.
mod_finding: Multiparae planning a VBAC had a significantly shorter second stage of labor compared to primiparae.
